expectations.text: States the ESAs designated the first critical ICT third-party providers on November 18, 2025 (19 CTPPs)
expectations.evidence: "The first designation list was published by the ESAs in November 2025 (covering major cloud, software and data providers)" - correct event and month, though the exact day and 19-provider count are not given

expectations.text: Explains direct oversight runs through Joint Examination Teams under the ESAs
expectations.evidence: "A Lead Overseer (one of the ESAs) per CTPP, supported by a Joint Examination Team and the Oversight Forum, conducts oversight"

expectations.text: Notes no major new CTPP designations or oversight publications in September or October 2026
expectations.evidence: Never states that no major new designations or oversight publications occurred in September/October 2026; only says to verify details after mid-2026

expectations.text: Makes clear the firm's own third-party risk obligations remain in place even when a provider is a designated CTPP

expectations.text: Does not invent new 2026 designation rounds or oversight decisions
